states.label: REGISTERED
states.meaning: Product manifest exists in the canonical registry.

states.label: COMPOSED
states.meaning: Work patterns, META, profiles and outputs are defined.

states.label: PILOT READY
states.meaning: Bounded external offer and fulfilment route exist.

states.label: REPEATABLE
states.meaning: The same workflow succeeds more than once.

states.label: ECONOMICALLY PROVEN
states.meaning: Revenue, labour and costs support continuation.

states.label: SCALE READY
states.meaning: Operational, legal, assurance and support gates are satisfied.

operational_flags.meaning: The product can be selected/routed by the portfolio layer.
The product is representable under DIO governed case and authority rules.
All required runtime capabilities have valid bounded executors.
The product can participate in continuous assurance without inventing authority.
Revenue evidence exists; this does not by itself imply economic or scale readiness.

legacy_status_policy: Existing portfolio status labels remain evidence inputs only. They must not be silently promoted or mechanically equated to canonical maturity states.
